description: Extracts mineral reserves data tables from farmonaut.com mining pages, including USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries with country-level reserves, global share percentages, and supply risk assessments.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_mineral_reserves: Extracts the main mineral reserves table from a farmonaut mining URL (requires url); 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_all_tables: Extracts all tables from a farmonaut page (requires url); 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: Full URL to the farmonaut mining page (e.g., https://farmonaut.com/mining/usgs-mineral-commodity-summaries-rare-earths-reserves-by-country)
